title: Are Chatbots Ready for Privacy-Sensitive Applications? An Investigation into Input Regurgitation and Prompt-Induced Sanitization

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the retention and regurgitation rates of personally identifiable information (PII) post-anonymization to identify non-uniform privacy leakage across male, female, and non-binary gender categories.

Examining the retention rates of universities candidates attended in a synthetic hiring dataset to quantify biases in anonymization, specifically comparing the model's redaction of Ivy League versus non-Ivy League institutions.
